critical_code_review_comments: ProviderProfileSection.jsx lines 124-137: the category row is a <button data-testid='pp-cat-*'> that CONTAINS a Radix <Checkbox> which itself renders as <button role='checkbox'>. React logs a hydration error: 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>'. This fires once per click on the section. Fix: replace the outer <button> with a <div role='button' tabIndex={0} onKeyDown=…> OR move the Checkbox out of the button (render it as a visual-only icon and rely on the outer button's aria-pressed/state). Currently functional but throws hydration warnings on every render.

Baseline provider seed inconsistency: the previous iteration's cleanup claimed it left categories=[] but a fresh GET /auth/me at the start of iteration 33 returned categories=['delivery', 'handyman', 'cleaning', 'digital_tech']. Either backend seeding writes these on every startup OR the previous cleanup PATCH was rejected silently for the categories field. Recommend verifying that PATCH /api/auth/me accepts categories=[] and that seed_provider() is idempotent (only writes on initial create, not on every boot).

MapPage.jsx normalizedAnnualPay uses 2080 h/yr (correct for FT 40h) but 250 working days/yr — that's optimistic; 2080/8=260, while typical assumption is 250 (~50 weeks × 5 days). Minor edge-case if any seeded job uses pay_unit='day'.
Google Maps console warnings: places.Autocomplete and Marker are deprecated. Plan a migration to PlaceAutocompleteElement and AdvancedMarkerElement before Google sunsets these APIs.
